operators.name: unfold

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided, but kernel will handle via strides

semantics: Output is contiguous with shape [N, C*kernel_h*kernel_w, L] where L=out_h*out_w.
Each output column corresponds to a patch starting at (i, j), flattened in row-major order of the kernel with dilation.
The mapping follows the reference nn.Unfold's memory layout exactly.
Performs unfolding on input x of shape [48,3,512,256] with kernel_size=(3,5), dilation=(1,1), stride=1, padding=0.
Produces output tensor of shape [48,45,128520] on cuda device, dtype float32.
The operation is equivalent to extracting each (3,5) patch with dilation 1 and flattening them into a column, arranged in row-major order of the output spatial positions.
Returns the unfolded tensor as the final output, same as step_001 value.
